verdict.rationale: Replication and high availability with a consistency model is a fair question for a managed vector database like Pinecone, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions cross-node or cross-zone replication, HA, or a consistency model. Backups and index copying are a different capability (data protection, not live replication) and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can replicate data across nodes or zones for high availability with a documented consistency model
